response.overview: Baggage Claim is a campus comedy of errors sparked when Sanah accidentally picks up the wrong grey duffel bag, swapping her roommate Joshua’s bag with one belonging to Ritvik, a student drug dealer. The mistake sets off a chaotic chase involving Ritvik’s intimidating client Biju, a suspicious warden, a drugged-up Joshua, and several attempts to recover and conceal the bag. After a series of confrontations and misunderstandings, Ritvik and Biju are caught—but the bag escapes once again, ending up with an unsuspecting professor in the film’s final twist.
response.title: Baggage Claimed!
